configurations.name: backend
configurations._comment: Runs the FastAPI app for previews on :8000 (no --reload; make dev-backend is the dev loop). --directory matters: the app resolves its data dir relative to cwd, so run from backend/ like the Makefile does. Port must match the frontend's Vite proxy target.

configurations.name: frontend
configurations._comment: Vite dev server; proxies /api and /ws to the backend config on 8000, so start both.
